listing.name: Knack — knack_pc (AbdelmoumenDeghbouche)
listing.summary: Upstream reports early chapters with fights, story videos, music and saves at up to 120 FPS on Windows. Later chapters and Linux gameplay are untested. Dust edges, startup text glitches and possible memory growth during long sessions remain. Local trophies use user/trophies.txt and numeric notifications; trophy names, platinum and PSN integration are not provided. Portcove has not confirmed these features or performance. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own decrypted CUSA00068 base game and 01.10 update. Merge them using upstream’s instructions or select separate game and update folders. PKG extraction scripts require your own dumped base and update packages.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README for v0.1.0 knack-windows.zip with Knack.exe or knack-x86_64.AppImage. Select the game and optional separate update folder, then Play. First launch prepares shaders. Windows source builds use MSYS2 CLANG64 and Python; Linux has separate packaging scripts.
